title: How a Man of God Goes Home for the Holidays Without Becoming 16 Again
caption:
You walk into your parents' house and within an hour you're 16 again. Sleeping till 11. Snapping at your brother. Skipping the quiet time you never miss at your own place.

Home has a way of pulling out the old version of you.

Keep your morning. Don't take the old bait. Do the dishes before anyone asks. Decide your limits before you see the old crew.

“A soft answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.” Proverbs 15:1

Send this to the brother you'll see at the table this year.
